name: Lemon-Blueberry Muffins with Cinnamon Streusel Topping

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners and set aside.
Place butter in a small saucepan and melt over medium heat.
Meanwhile, place flour, sugar, and cinnamon in a small bowl. Add melted butter and stir until combined and crumbly. Set streusel topping aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup all-purpose flour
granulated sugar
½ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Place additional flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in large bowl; whisk to combine the dry ingredients and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
all-purpose flour
1 tbsp baking powder
1 tsp baking soda
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, zest, and juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add sugar, oil, and eggs, then whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lemon
⅔ cup granulated sugar
½ cup neutral vegetable oil

instructions.primary_message: Add buttermilk and vanilla to the bowl with the egg mixture and whisk once more to combine the wet ingredients. Set aside.
Place frozen blueberries in another small bowl. Add flour, stir to coat, and set aside.
Add wet ingredients to the bowl with the dry ingredients and gently stir until batter is just combined.
Add floured blueberries to the bowl and stir to incorporate (take care not to over-mix the batter).

Fill the muffin liners three-quarters full with batter, then sprinkle with streusel topping. Place muffin pan in the oven and bake until a toothpick inserted into the center of a muffin comes out clean, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly, about 10 minutes.
To serve, arrange cooled muffins on a platter and enjoy!
